reasons.plausibility: The mechanism of thermally activated diffusion and phase stability changes is broadly consistent with established metallurgical principles for high-entropy alloys, though it omits specific Mg-related considerations.
reasons.testability: Examining microstructure and property changes before and after systematic high-temperature exposures is directly feasible and would clarify whether phase decomposition correlates with property shifts.
reasons.usefulness: It provides a plausible framework for studying the role of diffusion and stability on performance, but more detail on the role of Mg and intermetallics would increase its practical value.
